summary: Gov. Henry McMaster (Republican) was term-limited, so the seat was open. Alan Wilson (Republican) won, defeating Jermaine Johnson (Democrat).

candidates.name: Alan Wilson
candidates.bio: Alan Wilson is South Carolina's attorney general, in office since 2011. He won the 2026 Republican nomination for governor in a runoff.

positions.summary: Says he will fight to eliminate the state income tax and supports exploring cuts to personal property taxes for seniors and veterans.
Says he would support rural clinics, expand telemedicine, and offer incentives for medical professionals to serve underserved areas.
Says he would deny state benefits to illegal residents and back state and local efforts to help federal immigration enforcement.
Says he would fully fund public schools and expand school choice.
Says he is "firmly pro-life and will always support laws that defend the unborn."

candidates.name: Jermaine Johnson
candidates.bio: Jermaine Johnson has served in the South Carolina House of Representatives since 2020. He was the Democratic nominee for governor in 2026.

positions.summary: Says that as governor he would increase the focus and funding for trade schools and tech academies.
Says that if data centers come to South Carolina, it should be a net-zero for South Carolinians, which he calls "Bring Your Own Energy."
Says women's healthcare decisions should be between a woman and her doctor.
Says he wants to expand Medicaid, fund rural hospitals and guarantee an OBGYN in every county.
Says he wants to lower income and property taxes for working South Carolinians.
Said he does not support current ICE operations in the state "in the way that they're doing it now."

factCheckNote: Winner matches AP-sourced tally (MultiState governors tracker, updated Nov 4, 35 of 36 races called). Vote totals read Nov. 25 from thegreenpapers.com. Write-ins are in the total. abcnews4.com reported that the State Election Commission certified the results, but the certified count itself was not opened, so the race is not marked certified.
